theme: AF-1/AF-4 ai_extract::<T> runs and extracts are audited
text: CHECKER + INTERPRETER + CODEGEN: `ai_extract::<T>(prompt)` with T in i64, f64, bool, Uncertain<i64>, Uncertain<f64> now runs on `axon run` (tree and VM; it checked clean and then panicked 'not callable', exit 101) with the same answers as a native build; one mapping (builtins::ai_extract_target) gives the T set to infer, interpreter, effects and codegen. Any other T is the new E1304 at check (it checked clean, panicked in the interpreter and was dropped natively), also when the call is never reached. With no asi-runtime build, no AXON_AI_MOCK and no AXON_AI_REPLAY recording, every extract is E1300 exit 5 (ai_extract_uncertain_* was a 101 panic). RUNTIME/AUDIT: every extract on every path (mock, replay, live) appends one ai_call provenance record at the decision model's tier (cheap / claude-haiku-5-5 with no AXON_AI_MODEL_* override) and is added to ai_cost_spent(); live tokens come from the response usage (they were stored as 0), a 0-token replay entry is charged at the prompt estimate, and a call's micro-dollar cost rounds up so a call that reached a model never costs 0.
